brand.label: The brand need that counted twice
brand.explanation: A level fifty druid wields a long bow - shooter power three - wears a firebrand ring, and carries five identified plain arrows. The brand-the-ammo test appeared twice in the inventory scan with the same condition, so the single qualifying stack added twenty to the need-brand trait instead of ten. The correction keeps the copy that sits with the enchant logic: ten.
